states: Private mock stack (8-node estate; every node carries an operator-style display name such as West Production C for pve3) with a local-only generator overlay: pve1, pve3 and standalone2 report the legacy sensors -j payload with a SATA disk lacking a current temperature, so the registry sets sensorSetupOutdated on those three nodes. Frontend served by Vite from this tree; backend binary built from dace9295c6 with the overlay (main's later commits do not touch this data path).

Three affected nodes: 'Affected: Automation Lab Standalone (standalone2), West Production A (pve1), West Production C (pve3).', sorted by table label, on Overview and Storage at all four viewports, with no notice or page overflow and no console errors; the action link targets /settings/infrastructure.

The nodes table container measures 1320, 695 and 385px at 1440, 768 and 414 wide and shows display names; at 375 wide it measures 346px (its narrow layout) and labels rows standalone2, standalone1, pve1. The notice carries both names, so each layout can match it to a row.
Single affected node (pve3 only, earlier revision of this change with the same label output): 'West Production C (pve3) is using an older temperature monitoring setup ...'.

Before control on the same stack with origin/main's sensorSetup.ts and PlatformOutdatedSensorSetupNotice.tsx swapped in: 'Affected: pve1, pve3, standalone2.' above rows labelled Automation Lab Standalone, West Production A and West Production C.

Labels that already contain the node name (pve2.lan, 'Rack 4 (pve3)', quoted, case-only) and labels that only resemble it (PVE3 for pve-3, pve5-backup, pve10 for pve1, a Kelvin-sign lookalike) are covered by sensorSetup.test.ts only; every mock node carries a distinct display name. The last edit after the pass was a code comment.
Mock data only; not a real pre-rc.6 SSH node or a real operator-renamed cluster.
